description: tech parameter is not connected to a physical PDK abstraction for layout generation.
resolution_action: Keep the locked FreePDK45 V1 contract and route adapter implementation through it.

Control-logic physical implementation has been defined but is not implemented.
resolution_action: Enter M12C3A only after this correction gate closes.

resolution_action: Keep OpenRAM in backend-adapter scope only.

description: Existing OpenYield control-logic candidate GDS files were not all trustworthy reusable cells.
resolution_action: Preserve qualified/quarantined split and do not re-upgrade candidate GDS trust.

description: Pin and rail metadata coverage is incomplete across the full TIME primitive hierarchy.

description: Candidate control region insertion is expected to affect or at least challenge the current top-level bbox contract.

description: OpenRAM control logic remains reference-only and cannot be directly reused as final OpenYield implementation.
Several transistor-level primitives and size variants still lack a parameterized physical generator plan.
resolution_action: Use corrected unit normalization, source-derived variants, fixed-50nm policy, and verified OpenRAM bootstrap mode as the implementation contract.

description: FreePDK45 physical tech rule binding is still not connected to the OpenYield control-logic parameter contract.
resolution_action: Treat channel length as fixed 50 nm in V1 and reject non-50 requests explicitly.

description: Legal provenance and qualification boundaries for direct standard-cell-style reuse remain incomplete.
resolution_action: Keep adapter scope at BSD-3-Clause OpenRAM backend reuse and do not claim direct OpenYield hardmacro reuse.

description: Incorrect dimension normalization created invalid NW0/PW0/L0 physical names.
Logical aliases such as PINV1 may represent multiple physical parameter variants.
resolution_action: Key physical identity by source path plus parameter tuple, not by alias alone.

description: OpenRAM does not support arbitrary channel length.
resolution_action: For FreePDK45 V1, lock channel length to 50 nm and reject any non-50 request explicitly.
